title: CropWater-RS: Remote Sensing-based Crop Water Requirement and Phenology Toolkit
description: CropWater-RS is a desktop scientific application for parcel-level crop monitoring and irrigation-water analysis using Sentinel-2 vegetation dynamics, temporal reconstruction, direct Kc-NDVI relationships, ETc/CWR, simplified net IWR, QUANT phenological partitioning and parcel-level spatial visualization.
